props.title: Arrive. Breathe. Be fully with yourself again.
props.subtitle: When everyday life drains you and you long for calm: In my studio in Berlin-Pankow you'll find a protected space where your body softens, your mind grows quiet and your breath deepens. Yoga, Pilates, massages and healing work – entirely at your own pace.
props.imageAlt: Wooden jetty at the autumnal lake

cards.title: Yoga
cards.text: Hatha, Vinyasa and Yin Yoga in small groups – here you are truly seen. Feel how tension dissolves, your breath deepens and the inner noise finally grows quieter.

cards.title: Pilates
cards.text: A strong, pain-free core begins with conscious, controlled movement. Strengthen your back gently and lastingly – in certified prevention courses where your health insurance may contribute to the cost.

cards.title: Massages
cards.text: An hour just for you, in which you have to do nothing and may let everything go. Soothing touch for body and soul – with special experience in pre- and postnatal massages.

cards.title: Healing Room
cards.text: When you sense that something deeper wants to heal: shamanic energy work and gentle guidance for the themes that truly move you. Mindful, grounded, fully with yourself.

cards.title: Singing Mantras
cards.text: Let your voice flow free and feel how sound releases you from within. Singing Mantras and Medicine Songs together – carried by the warming power of community.

cards.title: Wheel of the Year
cards.text: A circle of women that carries you through the year: 8 gatherings at the Celtic Wheel of the Year festivals. Rituals, honest connection and the good feeling of not walking alone.

props.title: How lovely that you're here – I'm Runa
props.text:
Maybe you know this feeling: always in motion, always there for others, and yet never truly arrived. This is exactly where I begin. In my studio in Berlin-Pankow I hold a protected space for you – for Yoga, Pilates and holistic healing work, entirely without pressure to perform.

With many years of experience and a great deal of heart, I accompany you in strengthening your body, letting your mind come to rest and giving your soul room again. You don't need to be able to do anything or bring anything – except yourself.
props.imageAlt: Runa, smiling cross-legged on the mat

props.text: Yoga is the journey of the self, through the self, to the self.

items.text: The yoga classes with Runa are the highlight of my week. Afterwards I always feel grounded, relaxed and full of energy – as if I had taken a deep breath.
items.name: Maria S.

items.text: The massages are simply wonderful. Runa has an incredible intuition and creates such a sheltering atmosphere that I can let go completely.
items.name: Kathrin L.

items.text: The retreat was a life-changing experience. The combination of yoga, nature and community touched me deeply and gave me new strength.
items.name: Sandra B.

props.title: Ready to fully arrive with yourself again?
props.text: You don't have to commit just yet. Simply write to me about what's on your mind right now – together and in all calm we'll find out what's good for you now.
